color_hdr_prores.hdr_note: PQ/HLG flags, component depth and color metadata are compared; metadata equality alone does not prove HDR visual fidelity.

timeline.method: all decoded display-order frames; exact rational best_effort_timestamp * time_base

source_generated_frame_diagnostics.method: same timestamps over common duration, full-resolution decoded RGB24; no resize and no temporal registration
source_generated_frame_diagnostics.interpretation: Raw PSNR/RGB SSIM penalize the intended grade. Normalized-luma SSIM and edge correlation are auxiliary structure diagnostics, not proof of texture preservation.

quality_metrics.method: same timestamps sampled uniformly over common duration; decoded full-resolution RGB24 for PSNR/SSIM/RGB MAE and CIEDE2000; CIEDE2000 converts sRGB to CIE Lab D65; LPIPS uses a 256x256 RGB downsample

delta_e_2000.color_space: CIE Lab D65 converted from decoded sRGB RGB24
delta_e_2000.note: 0 means no perceptible color difference in the evaluated RGB24 representation; interpretation thresholds depend on viewing conditions

lut_metrics.method: both 3D LUTs are linearly evaluated on the same uniform RGB grid; no video content weighting
